tbesh_html:
1) to be lifted up (meaning uncertain)
1a) (Hithpoel) to be lifted up, be displayed

strongs_1890.derivation: a primitive root; to gleam from afar, i.e. to be conspicuous as a signal; or rather perhaps a denominative from H5251 (נֵס) (and identical with H5263 (נָסַס), through the idea of a flag as fluttering in the wind);
